name: JW Pharmaceutical Corporation
summary: JW Pharmaceutical Corporation manufactures and sells medicines and medical supplies in Japan and internationally. It offers cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, urinary, oral hypoglycemic, antibiotic, anti-fungal, obstetrics and gynecology, renal, central nervous system, anti-anemic, respiratory, rheumatic arthritis, anticancer, anesthetic, antidote, amino acid and total parenteral nutrition, and other specialty pharmaceutical products. In addition, it offers wound care, pain care, and beauty care related products. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Gwacheon-si, South Korea.
